sanskrit: praṇavasaṃpuṭahaṃsabījatvādirūpamprayogāt, tato'pi cārpaṇaṃ puryaṣṭakārpaṇāyasparśamarpayāmi svāhā iti trirjuhuyāt, iti vīpsāto'vaseyamparyante sphuṭayiṣyāmaḥsaṃskārasaṅkalanā homakalanā ca smartavyātasya bhogenaivātivāhanādityarthaḥśodhayet, evaṃ hi nivīghnaṃ bhogasiddhirbhavatiprākkarmāgāmi caikasthaṃ bhāvayitvā ca dīkṣayettasya lābhādityalamśivamayyāḥ svasattāto bhraṃśitvā kravyādatvametityarthaḥtacchuddhividhiragre tu bhaviṣyativīryasāratāṃ mantrāṇāmāhaityāstāṃ tāvadetadagre vitatya nirṇeṣyāmaḥsahaikībhūtaṃ vibhāvayetprayogaḥ | home tu svāhāntaḥyasyām, na tu hṛdayaṃ, hṛnmantrasya nivṛttyantarbhāvātśikṣayatiākarṣaṇagrahaṇādyāstu dhāmnaivetyuktamvyāptirgrāhyā | "ādi" śabdādekacaitanyabhāvitoddhārādayaḥdīkṣāsviti śeṣaḥcaitanyamityarthātkāryamityarthaḥñādyāḥ ghāntākuryādityarthaḥkuryāt

sanskrit: dadyātyadatrānuktaṃ tatpūrvato yojyamgarbhīkṛtavakṣyamāṇaṣoḍaśabhuvanā mukhyānyāvaraṇānimantraniyama uktastatreśvarājñaiva niyantriketi sarvamanavadyamvakṣyamāṇayojanikākrameṇa yukto na jāyate, mucyate ityarthaḥśuddhirasya paramaśivābhivyaktirityuktamyojayediti śeṣaḥhutyādikarmetyarthaḥpraṇavo niṣkalanāthaḥkriyāviśeṣaṇamtadyuktamayuktaṃ veti sacetasaḥ pramāṇamityalamsaṃsthitaṃ saṃsthānaṃ yatratenātmavidyāśivatattvavibhāgenetyatrārthaḥmahādhvare dīkṣāprayojanaśivayāgetadantā vidyātattvasya vyāptiḥsvāheti prayogaḥkāraṇānāṃ kāraṇaṃ śiśoḥ śikhāgre dhyātveti saṅgatiḥna tu nirbījāyāmevapāśahomamantraḥ prayoktavyaḥsaṃpāditamsakalīkāro bhavadbhiḥ kārya iti śeṣaḥvimarśapadaṃ lambhayāmītyarthaḥyojanāyāmupayogītyāśayenātra vākye jñātveti dvirupāttammanaḥsaṃskārasyāpi kṣayātyatprāptyarthamiyān śāstrasaṃrambhaḥ

sanskrit: varṇādhvā sthitaḥprāṇarūpāstadātmakatvāt padānāmsamanāntapadarūpā | nirṇītaṃ caitat pūrvamevatadadūra eva nirṇeṣyatemantrāṇāmapyadhvateti yāvathānasamādānadharmakahakārasakāravimarśarūpatayā sphuraṇātiti etacca tatraiva vyākhyāsyāmaḥvrajeccidānandaghanaparabhairavasamāpattiṃ śrayetnādasyaiva nādāntāntā vyāptivīdhīyate yogibhiryatnena kriyatevyākhyātasparśānubhūtyante ityarthamevaṃ vyākhyātamhetutvamityadhikamatropakṣiptam.............ṣaṃsparśaṃ ca tato'paramśaktipadamityarthātārurukṣūn prati tu sthūlasthūlatarairityādyuktampūrvoktalakṣaṇaṃ yaśca tanmayatvamavāpnuyāteṣāṃ pūrvameva dhyānam, sādhanaphalaṃ cāgre bhaviṣyatiadhipa iti bhagavadīśvararūpaḥkāraṇamityuktamyathāhni prāṇe'ṣṭāvudyantyevaṃ rātrau apāne'pica vā(cyānya1)pi vyāpnotisamanānubhavaparyante unmanāntarbhāve tyajet praśamayetviśvakalanākāritvānna taṃ kaścit kalayatītyarthaḥityarthaḥśūnyatrayamāpekṣikatvāddheyamityarthaḥavicalatvādupādeyatvam

sanskrit: lokottaramityarthaḥsamo raso yasmin sa samaraso lolībhāvaḥtadviśrāntyaiva samarasīkuryātbhavantīti śeṣaḥgamiratra jñānārthaḥpadamavaṣṭa(bhnā)ti, yaditi yasmādevamsarvasyāsya prakāśamānatayā prakāśaghanaśivaikātmyāttaṃ parāparabhāgena punareva tridhā kurutuṭerardhīkṛtāyāḥ tridhā vibhajanamiti "punaḥ" śabdārthaḥsarvakālāvayavavyāpīparata iti samanāyāḥ, ya evātmana unmanāyogaḥśabdasaṃdarbhastadupāyatvāt śāstrasyaanāśritākhyaḥsa ityakārayukto hakāraḥ kevalastvanuccāryatvādakālakalita evatrimātratvaṃ gītikākṣarasvaramadhye'kṣaraśūnyapadoccāravatbheditagranthibhiryogibhiḥlalāṭāgratadagrabhāgātmanyantadvaye dvāvuccarata ityarthaḥsamaneti sthitiḥmātrārdhamātrādikālasparśarahita ityarthaḥvarārohe iti prāgvatjijñāsayādhiṣṭhitaḥ prathamaṃ viṣayīkṛta ityarthaḥtattvaṃ vīryasāro mantraḥkumbhakāvasara evamadhyanāḍirūpaṃ vicintayet na tu saṃpratyeva vāhayetvikasantītyūrdhvavāhonmukhībhavanti

sanskrit: cakārāt kumbhakamūrdhvarecakaṃ ca, tattvaṃ mūlamantraḥsvayamevamūrdhvaṃ prasaret | mantra iti arthātdhakadhakākṛtiśabdatulyākāraśrutiruccaratītyarthaḥtadrūpākāra uccaratītyarthaḥtadanukṛtirmakāraka(lpamu)ccaratītyarthaḥtatrāpi ṛāvādiśabdāḥ santyevaevaṃ bhedamayaḥ saṃsāraḥtathācāryasya bindunā" iti spaṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥityatra nāṃśabdasya lopa eśvaraḥśobhanaḥ prayatno divyakaraṇadhārādhiroharūpaḥbhavatītyarthaḥbhedasyāparityāgāditiātmānamiti śeṣaḥnityoditānandaghanasvātantryaśaktyābhāsātmatvenāvasthānātparasmiṃstejasi vyakte tatrasthaḥ śivatāṃ vrajetparamaśivarūpam ataśca śivatāṃ vrajet tadaikātmyamiyātnirupādhiparamaśivaikātmyametyevetyarthaḥetat pūrvavyākhyābhirgatārthamdvārarodhordhvavāhādharapadatyāgagranthibhedanādyātmāyadvadvahniśikhātītā tadvadyojayate parevyomni līnā tadaikyamāptā yadvat (tadvat)śiva eko bhaved devi avibhāgena sarvataḥmantrādivadbhedaviṣayamśiṣyamityarthaḥ | etacca dīkṣāntaraviṣayamapīti mantavyamparasvātantryaśaktirūpe

sanskrit: nādaśaktitanuścaiva vyāpinīkaraṇānvitaḥniyojayediti pūrvoktena saṃbaṃdhaḥparādiśaktitrayamayena ātmakalpenetyarthaḥprakṛṣṭātadabhedavimarśaparamārthampaśyati so'pyevam, tena tasyeti kartari karmaṇi ca ṣaṣṭhīparamaśiva evapāśānnikṛntatividyeśvarā iti mantreśvarasphārameva viśantiśivācārya eva hi ācāryo yuktaḥanyathā prāksvarūpeṇa ye paśyanti narādhamāḥsādākhyavatsaramānamekādaśe paṭale bhaviṣyatisthitamityabhimānaṃ niścitāṃ pratipattiṃ kārayet kuryāttyajedityarthaḥcaret, dvādaśāntaviśrāntaṃ kuryātyātivācake'ntarabhinnavācyātmatayā sthitāḥupādeyateti prāgvibhaktamevaprāpyatvenāvalokayati, na tvadyāpi prāptatadrūpaḥśuddhātmanastadbhāvanāprarūḍheḥunmanāśceti samāsaḥśabdācca tacchaktyāpitāvad bahiḥ kumbhak samyāa samantāt diśet prāpayettṛtīyā | tadarthamiti śoṣanivṛttayepṛthivyādīni tattvāni pañca pañcasu vinyaset

sanskrit: svacchasvacchandadhāmaprathanavaśabhavat sarvasarvātmarūpamtattvādidīkṣāprakāśanaṃ nāma pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥpracchanne'dṛśye | pūjayediti kāmanocitena saṃbhāreṇarūpaśca yo japastasmājjapato na tvakṣarapāṭhamātrādityarthaḥsvānubhavasiddhatāmasya darśayatipraṇavaḥparamārthaḥ paryavasitaḥyathāprakṛti saṃyukto na ca tiṣṭhati caikataḥtvasyākārayuktasyāpi nordhvapravṛttirbhavatītyarthaḥtadahelayā tvadanusaṃsmṛteryoginaḥ ||" itiyuktaḥ san pravartate ūrdhvamārohatītyarthaḥca catuṣkalanātho'pi niṣkala ityucyateniṣkalo'pi vicitredṛkkalāyogāt sakalaniṣkala ucyate ityarthaḥsandhānānmantraviśrāntyārohādityarthaḥparamakāraṇatvena paramaśivādvaiśiṣṭyamuktaṃ syāditiityanāhatanātho nidīṣṭaḥ, sa eva nirguṇatvāttattvato niṣkalaḥsakale japyamāne tu japto bhavati niṣkalaḥṣaṣṭhakalāyuktebhūya ityarthaḥvācyarūpāḥ pañca camahāvimarśabhittiṃ vinā kasyāpyasphuraṇādityarthaḥanyatantrasiddhāntavailakṣaṇyenetyarthaḥvaraṇānāṃ ca pūrvoktayuktyā praṇavatvampraṇavā iti prārambha evoktamasmābhiḥsarvatreti sādhakaputrakādiviṣaye

sanskrit: utkramaṇam = dehaviśleṣaḥākuñcanaṃ saṃdhisaṅkocaḥ | śoṣastālvādisthāneṣuyathoktavarṇaśabdādyātmānaścaite dhyātā vaśīkṛtā bhavantiiti yadupakrāntamabhūttannirvāhitambhavataḥyogijāgarā iti nirūpitaṃ bhavatisparśa ityarthaḥbhittvā krameṇa sarvāṇi unmanyantāni yāni tubhavatītyarthaḥkrameṇābhyāsaprakarṣānmantramantreśāditulyo bhavatītyarthaḥsaṅgatiriti śivamkālādhikāraḥ nāma saptamaḥ paṭalaḥtattanniyatadevatānusmaraṇaṃ yatsahajam, sa bhāvāṃśaḥspaṣṭamanyatsādhakapadena mumukṣūṇāṃ nāyaṃ niyama ityādiśatiśāstroktavidhānenetyarthātpunaryojayedāmantrākṣarasamāptiṃ yojayet"āyāntīṣṭetarārthāya bhavantyāyāstata" itirudrairavāpīti saṃkramaṇayuktyaivaitaḥ prabhṛti vaikharyāḥ prasaraḥiti trikahṛdayeaṃśakādhikāraḥ nāma aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥyogyadevīvyatirekeṇa naitadanyasyāpyuktamniḥśeṣavighnabhakṣaṇaparatvenavyādhyādhikāraṇabhūtamahāpāpabhakṣaṇa ityavagatam

sanskrit: dvātriṃśadakṣarādanyatvamityanuṣṭhānāntaramevaitatcatasṛṣu dikṣu dvāracatuṣṭayaṃ kalpayetdvātriṃśadakṣareṇa ca sakalamūtīrūpeṇa | tameveti pūrvoktamniveśayetgaṅgāyamunāpravāhayormadhyamantarvedī | narmadāyāmapi tattaṭekṣetrapālabalyādeḥ, vidhānaviditikartavyatājñaḥvaśe bhavatyataśca śivarūpaḥ sādhako jāyata iti yāvat| āśvāso hi akampaḥ siddhiliṅgamhomāntena vidhinā pūjayetsādhyamiti tannāmayathāsthānam, yathālekhotpuṃsanaṃ ca sampadyatejvalantaṃ cintayet sādhyaṃ dinānāṃ saptakaṃ yadiśatrusaṃhārocitamugraṃ cintyamyadevaṃvidhaṃ mantraṃ likhitvā sampūjya japa homau kāryauśriyaṃ cāpnotimadhuratrayaṃ prāgvatsatatamabhyavaharato na mṛtyurbhavatiphaṭ" iti krūrajātyanta ūhaḥ prayoktavya ityarthāttāḍayedityarthātdaṣṭaṃ bhakṣitaviṣaṃ caāmagokṣīrapiṣṭatvaṃ sthitamevaaśvamāraḥ karavīrakamāragvadhamārocakamiti prasiddhammadhuyaṣṭirityanyecādhyāhāryam | trilohaṃ hemarajatatāmram

sanskrit: navamaḥ paṭalaḥsādhayatāmācāryādīnāmanena straiṇabhogaprādhānyamevaiṣāṃ bhuvanānāmupodbalitambāhye'nantabhuvanambālāgrāṇi tathā tvaṣṭau likṣeti parikītītāaṣṭau yavā varārohe parvāṃguṣṭhamathāṃgulamtāladvayaṃ bhaveddhastaścatuvīṃśatikāṃgulaḥparvaṇo'ṅguṣṭhamaṃgulamiti paryāyaḥ, vitastestu tālaḥbhūrādilokadāha itiduḥkhānubhaveneti narakāḥ kathitā iti mahāsaṃhitāsubhūyobhūyaśca jīvanaṃ tau sañjīvanasujīvanau..............kṣuradhāro'siparvataḥityuktaḥ | asiḥ khaḍgastanmayaśca parvato gacchatāṃ duḥkhadaḥiti niruktaḥmīnakharayorudare mahāsantāpade yatra janāḥ pīḍyanteyatra | vaḍavāmukhākāro dāruṇo'nalaḥ santāpano yatrayatra krakacairaṅgacchedanam | yatra ca śūlāropaṇamvileṣu janmayatra dravye bahumūtramadhye'medhyamadhye ca nivāsaḥ..............vṛkāsyaśca tathaiva ca"tamaḥsaṃjño mahāmohaścaitanyaguṇamohakaḥ | " iti niruktaḥvṛṣṭimudgarāvaśanirūpau yatropariṣṭāt patataḥvṛścikairdaśyante | kālaḥ saṃhartṛpuruṣapūrṇaḥyatra śivābhirārāvairjanāstrāsyanteityuktaḥ

sanskrit: śodhayetuttaraṃ karma kāryamiti śeṣaḥteṣāmayutāyutamantanīvāsasthānamiti vyākhyeyamavyaya iti sadā āpyāyādi kurvannapi na kṣīyateeka evāyaṃ nānāsaṃjño nānāvyāpāraścetyarthaḥpravartayatyudbhinnāṅkurān sampādayatietannāmaivetyarthaḥpañcāśatiyata īdṛśāstataḥ sattvavahā ityarthaḥaśanivīdyut | teṣu megheṣuraivata iti tadākhyaḥ | puṣṭivahākhyo meghaḥuttamāstu vidyādiprabhāveṇaiva tattaddeśaprāptimantaḥprasiddhā mṛtā ityarthaṃḥvimānaiḥ svabhūmiprāpaṇamiti śrutau teṣāmanuttamatvenoktatvāt | tata iti svabhūmeḥsiddhāḥ sampannāḥgandharvasahadhamītā gāndharveṇa maheśvarārādhakatvamtasyopari brahmajā meghāḥ sthitā iti saṅgatiḥupadravaparirakṣākapālotthā iti mamaivetyarthātrudraśaktyadhiṣṭhitāḥtattatpadocitayogasiddhairadhiṣṭhitā āsāditāḥāyudhānāmeva ca taddevatānāmapūritairiti yojyamdharma ā samantāddhāryate darśanasparśanādinā sampādyate yayā

sanskrit: parimaṇḍaleti brahmāṇḍāntarākāśasya tathātvātdivi bhavaṃ divyaṃ lokottaramamṛtaṃ jalaṃ vahatiiti śrīmanmayasaṃgrahoktasatattvaḥbrahmaṇaḥ śaktinīrmātṛrūpāprakāśakatvamiti svarucyā vyākhyātam, tadasāratvādupekṣyamnakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ tārācakramahiṃsādyā yamāḥ1 | śaucādyā niyamāḥ2śūrāstīkṣṇadhiyaḥsatyalokastho brahmāṇḍenāpararūpeṇa bhuvarlokamadhye niyuktaḥitīyameva prakriyā sādhvīkathayāmiuktāḥatrāpi cānandapadamāgatāḥ svātmārāmā evetyarthaḥabhicārādyaihikakarmaparatayā kṛṣṇatvaṃ śabalatā cavedamātā | sarvā etā ākṛtimatyo devatāḥnikāyairanucarasamūhaiḥ saṃsevyateviṣṇubhaktā iti tadākāropāsāparāḥindranīlanibhairnālairyojanāyatagandhibhiḥupalakṣitairityarthaḥsvacchāścaasvairiṇya ityarthaḥkāmaniṣṭhā api jñānayogābhyāṃ na parihīyanta ityarthaḥicchā atra anujighṛkṣā, tāṃ vinordhvaṃ sṛjyanta evetyarthaḥtannivāsināmityarthātsvocitaṃ snānādi kurvatyo'ntaraṅgaparivārarūpāḥ

sanskrit: śaktirūpadharairmantrairyogaiśvaryasamanvitaiḥataścājñānaṃ hatvā paraṃ svarūpaṃ darśayatyevamucyante, anyathā tu ūrdhvordhvameva krameṇa bhogāya sṛjyantevṛddhiḥ pramāṇavibhavābhyām | sā cāgre vakṣyaterudrabhaṭṭāraka evānena vapuṣā sthitaḥbrahmā viṣṇurvai vaiṣṇave purebhagavatetyarthaḥvajrasārādadhikaṃ sāraṃ yasyapūjyante | evamuttaratrāpi yojyamagnirāja āgneyadikpatiḥ | evamanyatbṛhattantreṣuśateneti mukhyena | evamanyatrapariviṣṭo marīcibhiḥ parivṛtaḥdvitīyaka ityantasthāt kālāgneranyaḥyāvat | gatitrayaṃ devamanuṣyatiryagrūpamprāpyāṇi manyantekroḍīkṛtasya | bhūtaye karmopabhogasiddhyarthamgarbhīkṛtatanmātrendriya eva guṇaḥguṇatattvena saha prakṛtitattvasya tat parimāṇamityarthaḥnādāntāvaraṇamupalakṣitam | etaccāgre vyaktībhaviṣyatitādṛgbhiḥvārtādaṇḍanītimātraniṣṭhaiḥsattādyadvayavādibhiḥākāraḥ saṃsthānam | vicitrāṇi vividhaśobhābhāñjiityādirūpaḥ | puruṣākṛtīnīti tu sāmānyoktiḥ

sanskrit: sarvavādināmagamyamaprāpyamnānyathetyarthaḥpūrvanidīṣṭarūpaiḥkṣobhayitumaśakyamyugāntāgnisamatviṣāmeṣāmatidīptatvātkaṅkuṣṭaṃ rañjanadravyaviśeṣaḥśtanābhyām" "śailābhyām" ceti sahārthe tṛtīyehāvabhāvavidhijñāstu nṛttagītaviśāradāḥdharmaḥmahātmano mahāśarīrasyaanyatreti tāttvike tatsvarūpanirūpaṇapare tatra tatra śāstrenānānāmarūpabhogaiḥmaṇḍalaśabdena tadadhikaraṇaṃ bhuvanaṃ tatprāptyarthammaṇḍale iti saptamīpāṭhe prāptirbhavatīti yojanā kāryāvidhivaditi samayapāśaśuddhyantena vidhinetyarthaḥkurute" iti tu spaṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ | atreti śrībhadrakālībhuvanesaṃsthānāni bhuvanasanniveśāḥpradhānānāmapi pradhānabhūtairityarthaḥcaturasrānalaprabhamiti karmadhārayaḥ | atreti vijayākhye puretenetyāpyāvaraṇenaādhāramiti bhuvanamkṛtvaitadbhuvanaṃ rudrabhuvanaiḥ parivṛtamparamāṃ tanumityadhiṣṭhātṛdevatārūpāmmānasībhirmanonukūlābhiḥ | strīṇāṃ samūhaḥ straiṇammaṇḍalaṃ pradhānabhuvanam

sanskrit: tāntu tadadhiṣṭheyasyāhaṅkāreśvarasyasarva iti pañcāṣṭakarudrā api trinetrādirūpāḥjāṭharabhaumarūpādyagnirūpatayā sthitamityarthaḥsaṃdhyāyāmaruṇo guṇaḥ kiñcittamasā karburadhūsarābho bhavatiadhipatiḥye brahmāṇḍāntaradhikṛtāḥ | evamuttaratratulyaṃ ca maṇḍalaṃ parimaṇḍalamityarthaḥbrahmaṇo'pi hi tannirmātṛtvābhimānastenaiva dattaḥsūryasomātmakaṃ ca mūtīdvayaṃ kāraṇatayā vartateprakāśakaṃ maṇḍalamityuktam, ata eva sūryasannimampratilomakrameṇa bhuvanasaṃśodhanaṃ kāryamvicitrabhogasampādakā anya eva rūpādayo niryātāḥityuddhoṣyatekṛtamityarthaḥmānasyo manonukūlāḥśrīrdīptivīdyate yasya, ata eva dhūmabahulena dāvāgninopamitaḥbṛhadbhogamiti yathārthanāma | ūrdhvamityutkṛṣṭambhūtyā saha jātatvādbhūtijā ityuktāḥpāṭhaḥiti nāmāntareṇāpi paṭhitāḥnānyayogivadyogavaśādetatpadaṃ prāptātatrāstiupāsate tu tāṃ dekā mātaraṃ tanayā ivaanugrahārthaṃ lokānāṃ prādurbhūtā sanātanī
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahetyarthaḥtvetannāmarūpabhedena lokānugrahārthamavatīrṇāetatpurāṇeṣu prasiddhamevaruhatī (tyaṅka)3 ruhā vāmārdhabhāgagatācaikānaṃśākhyadevatātvenāpyavatīrṇetyarthaḥmahiṣāsuravadhāyāvatīrṇāpratyutaitasyaitacchaktyaṃśādhiṣṭhitatvādeva viṣṇutvametadvyākhyānāvasare ihatyadevagṛhānusāreṇa yojanā daśītāprajāhitakāriṇātatrāvasthitaḥ karotiindriyajayaḥ | itthaṃ cāsya yogasya saguṇatvameva vyaktīkṛtamparameśvaraśāstrāśvastabuddhayaḥityuktā iti prakriyābhedāḥtamoguṇordhvamadhirūḍhetyarthaḥtāvatpadaprāpakāṇāṃ parameśvarayogāttatrāvasthānamprakṛtiparyanto guṇatattvam, tatra tadavadhītyarthaḥuktāḥ, te'traivāntarbhūtatvāt pṛthagiha noktāḥśikhedasahitā aṣṭau ete pradhānatattvagatā īśvarā ityarthaḥparākāṣṭhā'vibhāgāvasthājahnvādicāruparyantā dvitīyā paṃktiriṣyateproktanītyā guruśiṣyarūpamṛṣipaṃktitrayametadityarthaḥvakṣyamāṇābhimānadevatārūpapuṃstattvāvaraṇaprayojanampararūpeṇāvasthitamiti vakṣyatiiti śrīmataṅgapārameśvare itthaṃ lakṣitāindriyapañcakamityarthaḥ

sanskrit: yena krameṇetyarthaḥśrīmataṅgapārameśvare vitatya vyākhyātāḥpuṃstattve śodhanīyamuktambhogyalakṣaṇaṃ yasya sa pudgalo māyāpramātādaśadikkamavasthitā ityarthaḥiti pūrvoktasvarūpaṃ smartavyamanyathā buddhipramātṛtvāyogātakṣararāṭ śambhurāḍiti dvautāniti śeṣaḥkṛtamatra pañca gurava iti pradarśanāyabhuvanamiti bhuvanānītyarthaḥproktabhuvanavibhāgena śodhanīyamduṣpariharāḥprabhavanaśīlaḥprakītītā vibhāgenāvasthitā uktāḥvarṇayiṣyāmimucyata ityarthaḥpraṇavākhyarudrapañcakāvaraṇasyopari sthitāḥpatyuranantasya | ataśca sa eva lakuleśādīnāṃ guruḥparamādvaitacidānandaghanaparameśvaraikyavyāpteranyat sarvamevaparaparāmarśātmano maheśvarasyeyaṃ vāgīśīti nirucyatekoṭyo'nugrahādhikārāyāvasthitā ityevamuktamīśvarayogināmanugrahapravaṇatvāt saumyetyarthaḥīkṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭirjñānaṃ caprāpteśvararūpam

sanskrit: rudrā īśvarasya parivārāḥpradhānabhūtāḥsamayāvaraṇamityekādaśa catubhīḥ saha pañcadaśa bhavantitadbhuvanadvitayarūpaṃ vidyāvaraṇametadityarthaḥtena vāmādibhuvanatrayaparivṛtametadicchābhuvanamatretyarthaḥtālūrdhvaṃ iti etāvadantamīśvaratattvāśrayamiti smaraṇāyasaṅkṣepeṇa, na tu vistarataḥ śodhayetnānārūpā api | evamuttaratrāpivakṣyamāṇapararūpāt sadāśivādanyo'yamapararūpa ityarthaḥ......śvetapadmāsanasthitaḥpañca brahmāṇi sadyojātādīni | aṅgāni hṛdayādīnivṛta iti vartatedaśāṣṭādaśabhedena caitaducyateprāgīśvarasyāsanapadmaṃ sahasradalamuktam| utsaṅgagateti | ākṛtimattve ātmaśivasyaāvaraṇacatuṣṭayasthāḥvilāsā yeṣāṃ taivīdyāvṛndaiḥ parivṛtā iti saṅgatiḥpuravarairupalakṣitāḥbindutattvasthānavyāptirūpamāvaraṇaṃ bindvāvaraṇamprāptamahāvikāsadīptiyogotkṛṣṭatvānmāṇikyamśaktidvayamūrdhvapraveśadātṛtvādevamabhidhānamevamuttaratrāpi svayamanusartavyambhuvana ityasmin nādāvaraṇaṃ gate bhuvanapañcaka ityarthaḥpradhānabhūtātataḥ suṣumṇābhuvanaṃ suṣumṇā tatra saṃsthitā
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tantrāntarājjñātavyamvai bhittvā sarvamidaṃ jagattatrasthāni bhuvanānyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatādvāreṇa vacmītyarthaḥbhuvanāni pravakṣyāmi tatraiva saṃsthitāni tuananteti trayasya samāhāraḥsarveṣāmityanantādyanāśritāntānāmteṣāmeva sve sve karmaṇi yojanapravartakaṃ nimittamśaktirapyanāśritādiśaktirūpatayā sphuratidvitīyāmimāṃ preraṇāṃ karotiete ca proktasvaśaktisahitā eva prerakāḥ preryāścaśivena pūrṇāhutiḥbrahmādyanāśritāntāḥiti sthityā parabhairavarūpāneva sampādayatīti śivambhuvanādhvadīkṣāvidhirnāma daśamaḥ paṭalaḥviśvakartuḥ parameśvarādabhinnameveti pratipāditaṃ bhavatinādāvaraṇarūpaṇādyavasareityarthaḥśaktimadrūpaparamaśivātmanāpunaranāśritādayastadvyatiriktāḥ kecitnirañjanaparabhairavasvarūpāvyatirekātāśritamanāśritabhaṭṭārakarūpaśivatattvāśritamityarthaḥnirmalo vimalaḥ śāntastvadha ūrdhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥsattā'stītyuktatvātkāraṇavyāptimiti śeṣaḥdaśītaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kramavyatikramaḥ paramārthādvayakramavastutattvapradarśanāyasampanna ityatra tātparyamśivaśaktisamāviṣṭatvādevaiṣāmanugrahakartṛtvambādhitatvādaparyālocitādvayavādasatattvamityupekṣyamevakriyāśaktyā''bhāsayatītyarthaḥsamanantaravakṣyamāṇatiryagūrdhvādharabhūmīrgacchantiūrdhvamiti śivaikyaprāptirevaiṣāmūrdhvagatirityarthaḥmāyīyam | ghore bhedamaye | atidāruṇe duḥkhabahaletrirūpaṃ guṇatattvaṃ jātamityarthaḥsattvaguṇarūpamiti guṇeṣu sthitāḥ itiṣaḍviṃśakamīśvararūpaṃ paramaṃ padaṃ yogaśāstre daśītamvrataviśeṣā uktā iti māyātattvameva tatra paramaṃ padamkairaṇādi siddhāntaśāstramucyaterājasamiha vivakṣitam | atheti pādapūraṇāyaiti prakriyābhedamātramastina tu pūrvavat paśurūpaḥsavyāpāra eva bhavatisarvatra īśvarecchaiva bhagavatī bhavatietadapi prāgeva nirṇītampuruṣāhvayamprapañcāneketi pūrvanipātavyatyayaśchāndasaḥanātmanyabhiniveśanāyānanurūpameva veṣṭayetsthūlairbhūtairdṛḍhaṃ gāḍhaṃ kṛtvā'yaṃ veṣṭito baddhaḥsa iti viṣayītatkāla iti bhāvijanmagatatāruṇyādisamaye ityarthaḥ

sanskrit: bhāvayanti vāsayatyantaḥkaraṇamiti bhāvā dharmādayo'ṣṭauīritānyudīritānivyaktībhaviṣyatitraya ityaiśvaryavairāgyadharmāḥakalkatā'pāpacittatāadhiṣṭhitā vyāptāḥyathottaramadharmādayaḥ prakṛṣyantedaityā yakṣaprāyā evasarvatrāviśeṣāt pṛthivyāmiti viśeṣacodanāyā anupapatteḥyonyānantyahetuḥnirdeśaḥ.......vastuśūnyāni suvratelaukikaṃ vārtādaṇḍanītyādipātañjalādau vibhūtipāde eśvaryasyāpyuktatvātpaśulokamatītamiti kṛtvāsarva eveha lokā ucyante | tadatītā atimārgasthāḥśivajñānamiti śeṣaḥsatatāvabhāsvarasarvābhāsakasvatantracidekarūpamsarvātiśayanirmuktamanādibhavavajītamyathoktatattvasvarūpamavaśyajñeyameveha yogaḥsaṃhārastathetidvighaṭikārūpaḥevaṃ daśa varṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇisandhyaṃśamānaṃ jñeyam

sanskrit: laukikavarṣasaṅkhyāmcaturyugaśatāni dvādaśābdasahasrāṇyekasaptatyā gaṇayetdivyānītyarthātsahasramānametaduktamsāyaṃ ca sandhyākālaḥkṛtvā | saṃhāra iti saṃhārakālaḥsaṃharatisatyalokordhvavatīni brahmabhuvanevipākaḥna tu manāgapi mlāyantikālāgnerdakṣiṇamevakālavahnyūṣmajo'sya prasvedaḥmaunīm, sāttvikīṃ tu daivīm | vyavasthayeti bhuvanādimaryādayā..........paśūn vai sthāvarāntagānnidrāsaṃskārasyādhikādhikataratvampaiśācādibrahmāntāmumukṣubhirāśrayaṇīyeti tātparyambhavantīti śeṣaḥbrahmāṇḍānuviṣayalokasthasyaviṣṇutvaṃ ca prāpnotītyarthaḥnijanijasāmarthyabhājo bhavanti.............ṝātrirvai tatsamā bhavetbrahmādilokeṣu sūryādīnāṃ prakāśakatvena kvāpyaśrutatvāt"āpastejasi līyante" (11-284) ityādikālāgnirudrādivaicitryeṇa sthita ityarthaḥ

sanskrit: tāvadantamaśeṣaṃ jagad gāḍhanidrāmūḍhamāstesvāmī śrīkaṇṭhanātha iha ṣaḍviṃśako'bhipretaḥahni tiṣṭhanti dinārambhe'bhivyajyantedinamitītthamatra varṣadinādivyavasthā kāryāityarthaḥbindvīśvararūpatāmāviśatitadātmā jāyata ityarthaḥtadante tanmayībhavatītyarthaḥsvādhikāraparisamāptau līyateparārdhakoṭiguṇitasya yaḥ kālaḥ, tadanāśritasya dinamsthānam, yāti, tadekātmā bhavatikaromīti saṅkalpaṃ vinā | śiṣṭaṃ prāgeva vyākhyātaprāyamprasādatastattvārthonmīlanena kathayeti etannirṇayamādiśaityāśayena praśnavākye guhyamabhihitamiti śivamśrīkṣemarājaviracitoddyotākhyavyākhyopete ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥprasādādi prāgvatvistaratastvagre dhāraṇāvasare bhaviṣyatipacane dahane caiva tejasyūṣmaṇi saṃsthitamupalabhyoṣmasampattaye ca dehe tejaḥ sthitamjñaptiheturyasya sa dvilakṣaṇo dviguṇaḥlakṣaṇaṃ yasyaata eva tanniyamaḥ śāstre kriyatebuddherjñānasya yogaḥ sambandhastatra tannimittaṃ pravartantedhvanimātrāvasthitāḥdalādiviśleṣoditāḥ

sanskrit: sūkṣmaḥ sarvajanāsañcetito dharmo'stirājasatāprādhānyadarśanāyasāṅkhyasiddhāniti, arthātbhavatīti śeṣaḥkatipayaṃ kālaṃ pṛthagbhavatiīśvarecchāta iti, arthātetat tribhirguṇairyuktatvāt triguṇamataśca ahamakartāsāṅkhyajñānamohitasyāstīti yuktamutpaśyāmaḥtadadhiṣṭhātṛvat tatraiśvaryamāpnoti | evamuttaratrāpi yojyamprāṅnidīṣṭadevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ jalamayaṃ svadehaṃ dhyāyetdehānucchvāsamātreṇa pūrayedāpyāyayetupalabdhiḥeṣa cābhyāsakālaḥ sarvatattvaviṣayo mantavyaḥpunarbandhāvirbhāvasyoktatvādevaiti bahuvacanaikavacanayorāśayaḥkvacicchabdenāsambhāvya evāyamartha ityādiṣṭaṃ bhagavatārūpavānityādityavarṇatvādidhyeyarūpa uktaḥdakṣavāmabhāgayoḥ sitāsitatvena dharmādharmotthāpakatvamuktamproktasitāsitātmakadvirūpayuktāsvabījaṃ navātmasambandhī lakāraḥyāvatproktakāladhyānādapītyarthaḥsitavarṇāṃ kalāṃ dhyāyeccaitanyonmīlinīṃ tu tāmdhyānakramasākṣātkārato vedyīkaraṇīyānitattaddevatādhiṣṭhitamūrtīnyeva sarvatattvāni dhyātavyāni
source_edition: Muktabodha  (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadrūpatvādeva ca pumbandhikā māyā granthirityucyateanyaśāstramamāheśvaramityādidhyānābhidhānātsiddhā vaśavatīnyaḥ saptakoṭisaṅkhyā vidyā yasya...............'śvamedhāyutasya caphalamāpnotiīśvarasya | trinetraṃ dhyāyediti tathaivetyasyārthaḥbhavatīti śeṣaḥjīvanmuktimāsādayatedehastho'pīśvarabhaṭṭārakatulyo bhavatipūrṇāhaṃbhāvamayo'yam | śiṣṭaṃ kāvyamātramyāvatitiśabdo'dhyāhāryaḥtatsiddhiphalaṃ tatsamatvāvāptiḥmokṣaṃ dadātidvitīye'bde sadāśivaikātmyamityevaṃ padaṃ bhavatibindurūpa iti, arthātityādivakṣyamāṇarūpamupādeyamrūpaviśeṣāḥ | guṇarūpā anupādeyāḥcalanasyākāro yasya, sphurattārakātulyamiti yāvattatra pratipāditaḥparāmraṣṭavyaḥ | dhyāyediti svavimarśabalena vimṛśediti yāvatityādyuddeśeṣu cadehāvasthāyāmapīti yāvatsiddhirapyatratyā muktiparyavasāyinyeveti śivam

sanskrit: dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥyāgastadārādhanaprakārastaṃ dvividhaṃ kathayasaiva pūrvoktaivakaratalaprāptasarvasiddhikā yathāruci vilasantītyarthaḥsādhyaṃ yathāviniyogāya vāyuvegādityatiśīghramānayatiapīti pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥsūkṣmaḥ kālaḥrātrāveveti sthitamevadvitīyādidinapuṣpāṇāmityānupūrvyārthaḥpītajalaṃ kuryātdakṣiṇenasavyata iti dakṣiṇe pārśve | atrāpyamukamākarṣayeti prayogaḥtrayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥdarśanīyā................khaḍgamudrāṃ nibodha mepāśastu kathito hyeṣa duṣṭajālanibandhakaḥiti pāśadhāraṇavaśāt prathayānaḥ kālakālastvam ||" itibhavati | asyāpi satattvamuktamevaguravaḥvāmahastamadhaḥ kṛtvā uttānaṃ tu samāhitaḥubhayorapi saṅghṛṣya vajramudrāṃ pradarśayetsuṣireṇa samāyuktaṃ darśayettu varānanetattvamasyāḥ pradaśītamevavallakīṃ vīṇāmdaśītameva

sanskrit: purātanapustakānveṣaṇato yāvadgati apasārita ityāstāmetatiti pūrvoktameva nirvāhitamvīryameva sārabhūtamiti śikṣayatiiti śivammudrāprakāśaḥ nāma caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥsādhakasyeti prācuryāśrayeṇaityavicchedena pāramparyeṇa | evamuttaratramuditeti muditaṃ harṣastaddhetutvātpadmamityevamabhidhātavyamityarthaḥ............ṝuhā jñeyā rajasvalālambikādirasasaṅgrāhitvātspaṣṭārthasaṃjñesarvān kāmān samavāpnotīti kṛtvādṛṣṭirdarśanavyāpāraḥ | caṣṭe vyanakti rūpamiti cakṣuḥsravaṇaṃ srāvaḥuddyotayatyajñānanivāraṇena jagaditi kṛtvāpārameśaḥ samayo'vaśyānuṣṭheyatvāt sammatamityuktaḥyo vīrācārāt pṛthagbhūta ityarthātyaḥ śastrahataḥ paśuḥ, taṃ labdhamityāmanantigamerjñānārthatvāt | phalamaśnuta iti tattadbhogabhug bhavatibhāvitātmatvaṃ sudṛḍha āśvāsaḥsampūrṇasiddhīvīdadhat svacchando jayati prabhuḥsphītasphūrjannirupamasudhāsphārasārasvaśaktiḥsvacchasvacchandacitsvātmasatattvaṃ nekṣate janaḥtenādvaitāmṛtasphītaḥ svacchandoddyota umbhitaḥ
